correctness.rationale: Wang–Zenger Lemma 6 gives \(\mathbf G(\alpha)\iff R_\alpha\subseteq R\). Lemma 5 fixes relational composition for words. Since \(R_x=R\), \(\mathbf G(x)\) is universal. Six explicitly listed frames were checked by direct relational composition and each satisfies exactly one of the other six conditions, providing a countermodel to every cross-implication. No bounded exhaustive search is used as a proof of an infinite statement.

value.rationale: This is the natural complete classification of the first nontrivial finite layer of the newly deployed GPC language. It distinguishes six basic structural constraints with tiny explicit counterframes, clarifying which structural rules can be selected independently in the modular non-contingency calculi.
